lines.en: The sword hangs loose in my right hand.
The shield on my left arm blocks the wind.
Only my footprints mark the snow.

lines.zh: 腰上挂着战利品，走起来叮当。
lines.en: Spoils clink at my belt as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是让别人先怕。
lines.en: I walk slowly so the fear arrives first.
Each step packs the snow down.

lines.zh: 护腕上的皮绳松了，我懒得系。
lines.en: My bracer's cord loosened; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 从峡湾走到这里，腿都硬了。
lines.en: From the fjord to here, my legs have stiffened.

lines.zh: 我边走边打量哪边好退。
lines.en: I walk and note which way to withdraw.

lines.zh: 风把我的头发吹到脸上。
lines.en: Wind whips my hair across my face.
Even standing, the sword stays in hand.
I tear off a strip of dried meat.
Deep scores mark my shield's face.
The trees here are too soft.
I rub the blade on my thigh.
I strike when it darkens.

lines.zh: 手指在剑柄上敲着节拍。
lines.en: My fingers tap a rhythm on the hilt.
I read the clouds the way I read the sea.
This snow is not clean enough.
I hang my helm at my belt.
I wonder if this voyage was worth it.
Someone is watching from afar.

lines.zh: 我活动了下手腕，骨节响。
lines.en: I roll my wrist; the joint pops.
Smoke in the distance — someone lives there.

lines.zh: 我蹲下摸了摸土，是湿的。
lines.en: I crouch and feel the soil. Damp.
I stand and shake off the snow.
Your hand shakes. Afraid of me?
You wear a scabbard. Too slow.

lines.zh: 我不认得你，也不打算认。
lines.en: I do not know you, nor care to.
Where are you from? Truth now.

lines.zh: 你把双手放在我看得见的地方。
lines.en: Keep your hands where I can see them.
Is there a village near here?
That cloth is not from here.
I smile; you step back.
I dislike crowded places.
You carry temple incense.

lines.zh: 我只问一次：你身上有值钱的东西吗？
lines.en: I ask once: anything of value on you?

lines.zh: 我们把话说清楚，省得打。
lines.en: Let us talk plainly and skip the fighting.

lines.zh: 护甲救了我，但肋骨响了一下。
lines.en: The armor saved me; a rib still clicked.

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，味道是铁的。
lines.en: I breathe in. The taste is iron.
I spit blood and lift the blade again.
The shield nearly flew; I caught it.
I lose a step, then take it back.
I grin through my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一下要是再深一寸就好了。
lines.en: An inch deeper and that would have been it.
I brace on my knee and rise.
Still standing. Then we continue.
Meat? Let me check it is not man-flesh.
Give me the ale first; I will repay you.
I will remember the kindness.
I chew loudly.
Do not stand between me and it.

lines.zh: 是蜂蜜酒吗？我更爱这个。
lines.en: Mead? That I prefer.
I sheath the sword.

lines.zh: 吃你的东西，就得说你的好话吗？
lines.en: Eat your food, praise your name?
Not enough, but enough to thank you.

lines.zh: 我把最后一块收进怀里。
lines.en: I pocket the last piece.
My shield is harder than your shoulder.
Steady. Do not fall toward the sword.
Who shoved me? Speak up.
I block with the flat of my hilt.
Watch where you walk and blame no one.

lines.zh: 窄路上剑柄撞上了你的肩。
lines.en: On this narrow path my hilt struck your shoulder.
That shove was a warning.
The edge nearly caught you.
Walk around next time.
My home is across the fjord.

lines.zh: 这话我会说，但不会现在说。
lines.en: Someday I will say it. Not now.

lines.zh: 我喝多了才会讲这种话。
lines.en: Only drunk do I speak of such things.
I set the sword down, then take it up again.
Survive first; the rest after.
I shake my head, a short laugh.
I am waiting for someone, far away.
There is no one suitable on this island.

lines.zh: 我把头发往后拨了一下。
lines.en: I push my hair back.
Not on a battlefield.

lines.zh: 一把匕首，正好藏在靴里。
lines.en: A dagger — good for a boot.
I bend; the hilt touches down first.
I know this silver coin.

lines.zh: 地上的是我的，除非你抢。
lines.en: What lies here is mine, unless you take it.
I slip it into my bracer.
Pick things up with your eyes elsewhere.
This hide is still useful.
I blow off the dirt.
Who died here?
Keep it. It will serve.
The sword comes out on its own.
You chose me. Do not regret it.
I strike first. Do not hold it against me.
That armor is good. I will take it.
I lift the shield an inch.
I have blocked the way behind you.
I hear you draw.
I do not intend to lose this.

lines.zh: 脚底下是雪，站不牢的是你。
lines.en: Snow underfoot — you will slip before me.
I spit out the grass stem.
You really want to try?

lines.zh: 我笑得太长了，你该警觉。
lines.en: My smile lasts too long. You should worry.

lines.zh: 我一动，你的眼睛就慢了。
lines.en: When I move, your eyes lag behind.
I settle my weight behind the shield.
Twenty years went into this sword.
Not my feet — watch my hands.
I am counting your bones.
Good. Now.
I am looking for the seams on you.
The farther you retreat, the slower I go.
The snow speaks. Your steps are loud.
I push the shield forward half a foot.
You do not move, so neither do I.
My point circles.

lines.zh: 你在算我的护甲厚度吧。
lines.en: You are judging my armor's thickness.
I know you are tired.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很稳，你的不稳。
lines.en: My breathing is steady. Yours is not.
The wind blows from your side.
This stroke comes down from above.
You are guarding too high.

lines.zh: 我把脚分开，像站在船上。
lines.en: I set my feet as if on a deck.
I wait for you to step on that ice.
You glance back. There is nothing there.
I use my shield's shadow to measure reach.
Blisters have opened on your hand.
I roll my wrist, hunting the angle.
Do not blink.
One step and I am there.
A diagonal cut toward your shoulder.
I jam the shield rim at your jaw.
The blade rips upward.
I cut at your sword hand.

lines.zh: 这一剑是维京的老套路。
lines.en: This is an old viking cut.

lines.zh: 你没挡住前面，后面更糟。
lines.en: You blocked the first; the next is worse.
Sword and shield come together.
I strike the ice and spray it wide.
One step back from you buys three from me.
That blow nearly notched the edge.
I grind my teeth and cut across.
The edge rakes your belt.
My shield pins your weapon down.

lines.zh: 我连砍两下，找同一个位置。
lines.en: Two cuts, both to the same spot.
I miss, but leave no opening.

lines.zh: 这一下我要留着你的甲。
lines.en: That one I mean to save your armor for.

lines.zh: 船坏在海滩上了，人还在。
lines.en: The ship broke on the beach; the men survive.
I am claiming this stretch.

lines.zh: 剑出鞘，说明我不打算聊。
lines.en: Blade drawn means I am not here to chat.
Wind blows snow down my collar.

lines.zh: 我把盾立在身边，像块门。
lines.en: I stand the shield beside me like a door.
So many came. Lively.
I crush a sheet of thin ice.

lines.zh: 我想知道这地方有没有酒。
lines.en: I want to know if there is drink here.
I read the ground before I speak.

lines.zh: 我把头盔戴上，绑带拉紧。
lines.en: I don the helm and cinch the strap.

lines.zh: 没人需要死，除非有人想。
lines.en: No one has to die, unless someone wants it.

lines.zh: 我看了看天，乌云压得低。
lines.en: I check the sky. Low, dark cloud.
The hilt is warm in my hand.
I come in carrying the smell of the sea.
These roofs are too low.
Words first, or blades?
I stamp the snow from my boots.
I stop and look at no one.

lines.zh: 火烧到皮甲，一股焦油味。
lines.en: Fire reaches my leather; tar-smoke rises.
I fall, and the snow does not catch me.

lines.zh: 冷水灌进鼻子，我呛得厉害。
lines.en: Cold water fills my nose and I choke.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻了两个身位。
lines.en: The blast throws me two body-lengths.

lines.zh: 咒语烧过皮肤，像被火舔过。
lines.en: That spell licks my skin like flame.

lines.zh: 三天没吃东西，剑都举不稳。
lines.en: Three days without food; the blade wavers.

lines.zh: 雷落在剑上，我整条手臂都木了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the blade and deadens my arm.

lines.zh: 什么也没有，我连雪都抓不住。
lines.en: Nothing at all — I cannot even grip snow.
